cardOverview.overviewText: The Standard Chartered Beyond Credit Card awards 5 reward points for every ₹150 spent on general purchases (≈ 3.33% effective reward), and 3 points per ₹150 on utilities, supermarkets, insurance, and similar essential spends (≈ 2% reward).It also includes perks such as lounge access and lifestyle/privilege benefits under SC’s Priority‑banking offering.

items.title: Discover Reward Points Redemption Options
items.subtitle: To explore the full range of redemption options for this card, download the SaveSage Club app now.
